name: tools-snes-spc700-player-v2-20
title: SNES SPC700 Player v2.20.1
description:
This is probably the best SPC player of them all. It has a myriad of features: speed/pitch change, channel mute, echo disable, DSP pitch/volume registers, etc.
Use the left and right arrow keys to toggle the data viewed during SPC playback.

See the Github page for the Changelog:
https://github.com/dgrfactory/spcplay/releases/
